name: tabvault-all-in-one
description: TabVault & Personal Assistant - All-in-One Life & Knowledge Management Platform

scripts.package:chrome: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist_pkg) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist_pkg }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist_pkg/tabvault-chrome, releases -Force; Copy-Item extension/* -Destination dist_pkg/tabvault-chrome -Recurse; tar -a -c -f releases/tabvault-chrome-v2.1.0.zip -C dist_pkg tabvault-chrome; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist_pkg"
scripts.package:firefox: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist_pkg) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist_pkg }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path dist_pkg/tabvault-firefox, releases -Force; Copy-Item extension/* -Destination dist_pkg/tabvault-firefox -Recurse; tar -a -c -f releases/tabvault-firefox-v2.1.0.zip -C dist_pkg tabvault-firefox; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist_pkg"
scripts.package:all: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run package:all
